label: Application
instructions: Use the supplied lines to distinguish retries followed by success from final failures.

criteria.normal: Successful application operation or routine informational event.
criteria.warning: Retry, recoverable exception, or degradation without confirmed final failure.
criteria.error: Unhandled exception, failed application operation, unavailable dependency, or data loss.
criteria.security: Explicit application authentication abuse, unauthorized action, attack, or security policy violation.
criteria.other: Insufficient application context or unrelated event.
